subject: Media Literacy
title: How Tracking Cookies Work
description: A short lesson to help you apply How Tracking Cookies Work.

hook.text: You search for running shoes once. For the next month, running shoe ads follow you across every website you visit.

buildup.text: Cookies are small files websites store on your device to remember you. Tracking cookies follow you across the web.

discovery.text: Third-party cookies let advertisers track your browsing across thousands of sites, building a detailed profile of your interests.

twist.text: Cookie consent pop-ups were meant to give you control. Most are designed to make accepting easier than rejecting.

climax.text: Browsers are phasing out third-party cookies. But companies are developing new tracking methods to replace them.

punchline.text: They kill the cookie. They keep the tracking. The method changes, not the goal.

quiz.question: What do third-party tracking cookies do?
options: Follow you across thousands of sites, building a profile of your interests
